findings.text: the source selection takes the receipt whenever the receipt yields any usable clock and consults the stream only as a fallback, where the plan's §6 entry point states one reading built from the freshest of the two; a receipt older than a stream reading therefore shadows it, and a receipt carrying only window_minutes 10080 discards a newer stream reading that observed the five-hour clock, so the group reports an unknown clock and an older age than the freshest recorded evidence supports. The rule is disclosed in the docstring and the landed record as the dialect fork, so this is a divergence to record rather than a hidden one, and today the two dialects are near-disjoint in production, which bounds but does not remove it.
